profile.headline: Lead IoT Embedded Software Engineer at BISSELL Homecare, Inc.
profile.summary:
Software developer with 20+ years experience in coding, testing, and establishing system improvements. Multifaceted problem-solver with experience in providing software/technical support in telecommunication and manufacturing industries. 

Skilled in developing user documentation and architectural systems.  Specialize in analysis and resolution of faults and developing and testing of software. Experience with effectively managing workflow with global counterparts to carry out the organizationʼs objectives. 

Knowledgeable with Assembly, C/C++, Visual C++, Java, Android Studio, Python, MFC, STL, multi-threading, socket, TLS,TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, Unix, Linux, shell scripting, Plant UML, Ceedling, OOD, TDD, Agile, RTOS, embedded programming.

positions.title: Lead Embedded SW Development
positions.description:
Subject matter resource for the ACE1000 platform software responsible for bare metal testing, Simics simulation testing and integration support to the FMS team.

Subject matter expert on the ACE1000 Data Load Application. Redesign and rewrote the ACE1000 Data Load Application in C after reverse-engineering a Legacy Data Load Application written in ADA. Software reuse applied when possible. Utilize Ceedling unit test to provide 100% code coverage which led to a shorter integration window in simulation and hardware.

Subject matter expert on the ACE1000 IO Application. Ported the Legacy IO Application to ACE1000 with over 95 percent code reuse.

Subject matter expert on Simics hardware simulator for the ACE1000. Utilize Simics for integration testing of the Data Load Application before testing on hardware

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained features for SIP and MGCP protocol on the HiQ8000.   The MGCP Signaling protocol is used for residential subscribers.  The SIP signaling protocol is used of UNI or NNI in a variety of solution (i.e. IMS, VAS, FMC).

Developed and maintained DQoS and PCMM protocol on the HiQ8000.   DQoS and PCMM are used for bandwidth management during a call.

Developed and maintained the Packet Cable Event Message signaling software on the HiQ8000.  This component delivers Event Message to RKS server via UDP.  Worked to ensure this component complied with CW28 certification.  

Developed and maintained the CAS (Channel Associated Signaling) software on the HiQ8000.  The CAS component manages 911 and BLV calls over CAS trunks.

Developed and maintained the CCM (Connection Control Manager) software on the HiQ8000.  The CCM component manages UDP connection to gateways and transmission and reception of MGCP/TGCP protocol messages.

Developed and maintained the VIP software on the HiQ8000.  The VIP component managed the virtual IP interface of several signaling applications.

Created a PC RKS simulator for testing the Event Message via the Radius protocol.

Created a PC simulator to simulate MTA subscriber, CAS circuit, MG trunks, COPS-DQoS server, COPS-PCMM server, SIP-subscriber and SIP-NNI.  Developers use this simulator to reproduce faults, test features, and regression testing of software.

Created a PC HSS simulator to simulate the HSS server and communicate via the Diameter Cx protocol.

Created a PC tool to display call-flow from HiQ8000 traces.  The tool provides a graphical flow of the internal and external messages which allow for more efficient analysis and debugging of software errors.

Created a PC tool to display a hierarchy of functions invoked during processing of a HiQ8000 event. 

Help trained new engineers to MGCP and CCM group.

positions.title: Principle Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Specialized in analysis and resolution of fault report for the ISDN PRI/BRI and EKTS call -processing component of the EWSD switch.

Worked on feature implementation for ISDN PRI/BRI and EKTS call processing component.   Played key role in the redesign and successful implementation of DISNE-MLPP feature.

Design and developed the PASP subsystem for the EWSD.  The PASP subsystem is a primary part of the integrated CALEA solution that manages the CCC and CDC connections.

Created a PC tool to assist in the group FR sourcing process.

Created PC tools to assist in debugging and analysis of binary EWSD traces.  The tools display a graphical call-flow of the trace, which allows for high-level analysis.  The tools also decode binary message into readable format.

Provided mentoring to co-ops and new members to the Y1 group.

positions.title: Apprentice
positions.description:
Manage ISDN/PRI SAP3 simulator testing for the Y1 group.
Source FR fixes into open release.
